data.name: Hyundai iLoad Long-Term Van Hire
data.description: Hyundai iLoad commercial van for long-term hire in Melbourne, 4,426 L cargo, from $100/day.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire the Hyundai iLoad?

acceptedAnswer.text: The iLoad starts from $100 per day, with better weekly and monthly rates the longer you hire. Call 0435 800 248 or request a quote for your exact rate.

mainEntity.name: Is the iLoad automatic or manual?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are available depending on the vehicle on the day. Let us know your preference when you enquire and we will confirm what is available for your dates.
The iLoad offers 4,426 litres of cargo space with dual side doors and a low load floor, making it ideal for tools, stock, deliveries and furniture.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire it long-term for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The iLoad is popular with trades, couriers and businesses that want a work-ready van on flexible terms without buying or signing a rigid lease.
